messages.subject: Kingsgate House, Farringdon Road – draft contract and title pack
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear James,

We act for Belvedere Estates Limited on the sale of Kingsgate House. Please find the draft contract, official copies of title NGL482190, the tenancy schedule and our draft replies to CPSE enquiries in the data room (link sent separately). The contract incorporates the SCPC (Third Edition – 2018 Revision).

Our client is keen to exchange by mid-April. We look forward to receiving your comments on the contract.

Kind regards,
Martin Greaves
Partner, Marlowe Greaves LLP
1 New Street Square, London EC4A 3TR
Ref: MG/RE/2026/0442

messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Martin,

Thank you – received with thanks. We're reviewing title and the contract now and have ordered searches. We'll revert with a marked-up contract and any additional enquiries shortly. In the meantime, please confirm the position on the Northbank Plc charge shown on the Charges Register – we'll need an undertaking to discharge on completion.

James Osei
Senior Associate
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
